public_rationale: Long-generation coherence failures are documented, including by the GPT-3 authors. Planning studies also offer relevant evidence that structured guidance can help. But these findings do not establish that inadequate reference, cognitive models and compositionality caused the failures. The interventions bundle several changes, and story consistency is not the same as factual grounding. The symptom is documented; the stated causal explanation remains unresolved.
limitations: Re3 is a later experiment and is treated only as context.
The post supplies no quantitative definition of empty language.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Neglecting reference, cognitive models and compositionality leads LLMs to lose coherence over time and drift into empty language with no clear connection to reality.
conditions: caused by inadequate attention to reference, cognitive models, compositionality

statement.excerpt: (a) the tendency of large language models to lose coherence over time, drifting into “empty” language with no clear connection to reality;
statement.document_title: Three ideas from linguistics that everyone in AI should know

from_speaker: inadequate attention to these three factors
the tendency of large language models to lose coherence over time
our_interpretation: The causal introduction applies to this bullet; the assessment therefore retains the proposed explanation instead of grading only the existence of incoherent output.
Over time means as a generation or discourse continues, rather than deterioration across successive model releases.
The ordinary measurable outcomes are loss of consistency, relevance and factual grounding over longer generations. Empty language has no separate technical definition.
The causal phrase is part of the proposition, not an antecedent of a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Controlled changes to reference, persistent state representations or compositional mechanisms establish that deficits in the specified capabilities materially cause worsening coherence and grounding over extended generation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Well-controlled tests show that the specified deficits do not materially contribute to length-related coherence and grounding failures, or reliably produce the opposite effect.

evidence.locator: Section 5, opening and following paragraph on text synthesis
evidence.explanation: The following paragraph reports semantic repetition, loss of coherence over long passages, contradictions and non-sequiturs. This supports the existence of the symptom, but does not identify Marcus’s proposed causes.

evidence.publisher: ICAPS 2022 SPARK Workshop; Nisha Simon and Christian Muise
evidence.explanation: TattleTale supplies planner-generated actions to GPT-J-6B and reports better narrative consistency. Its limited evaluation and lack of external factual-grounding tests prevent this from settling the broader causal claim.

evidence.publisher: arXiv; Kevin Yang, Yuandong Tian, Nanyun Peng and Dan Klein
evidence.explanation: Re3 reports better story coherence from a package of planning, repeated context, reranking and editing around GPT-3-based generation. The experiment postdates the claim and does not isolate the three linguistic factors or external factual grounding.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Matched interventions on contemporary models that vary the specified capabilities and measure how coherence and factual grounding change with generation length, while controlling for additional context and computation.
